candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the state variable is never updated.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` so the recorded timestamp is off by one.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the block number instead of the timestamp is stored.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check so calls with any value are accepted.
Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check so calls in the same block/timestamp are accepted.
Delete the statement pastBlockTime = block.timestamp so the recorded timestamp never updates.
Change pastBlockTime = block.timestamp to pastBlockTime = block.number, storing the block number instead of the timestamp.
Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 == 1, shifting when payouts occur.
Delete the conditional payout so the contract never transfers its balance back to the sender.
Change the transfer amount from address(this).balance to 0 so the payout sends nothing.
Delete the statement that updates pastBlockTime so the state variable is never written.
Replace the assignment pastBlockTime = block.timestamp with pastBlockTime = block.number so a different value is stored.
Change the timestamp guard require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) to require(block.timestamp >= pastBlockTime), allowing consecutive same-timestamp calls and thus altering stored values.
